sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation allows an expression containing bottom (`undefined`) to produce a value when the bottom is never demanded.
sketches.resonance: The thing that would destroy the program remains powerless as long as no one asks it to speak.
sketches.draft:
absence :: a
absence = undefined

here :: ()
here = const () absence

sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining short-circuits on `nil`, skipping every subsequent call and preserving absence as `nil`.
sketches.resonance: Once absence enters, every attempted continuation becomes another form of absence.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever because there is no channel endpoint that can ever become ready.
sketches.resonance: To wait for a voice that has no path to arrive is to become permanent waiting.
